html:
A Jewish rabbi, philosopher and doctor, born in Córdoba in al-Andalus around 1138, who spent his later life in Egypt. He is one of the most influential Jewish thinkers of all time.

When the Almohads took Córdoba and pressed Jews and Christians to convert, his family left. They lived in Fez, briefly in the Holy Land, and from about 1166 in Fustat, old Cairo. There Maimonides led the Jewish community and became a court physician in the circle of Saladin. He wrote medical works in Arabic.

His Mishneh Torah set out the whole of Jewish law in clear Hebrew. His Guide for the Perplexed, written in Arabic, tried to show that the Torah and the philosophy of Aristotle do not conflict, and that reason has a place in faith. It was read by Christian thinkers such as Thomas Aquinas and by Muslim scholars. A Jewish saying runs: "From Moses to Moses there was none like Moses." He died in 1204 and was buried in Tiberias.
sum: A Jewish rabbi, philosopher and doctor, born in Córdoba in al-Andalus around 1138, who spent his later life in Egypt. He is one of the most influential Jewish thinkers of all time.
